prompt:
A desktop landing page for "Oğulcan Cevizci — Full-Stack & AI Engineer", a personal portfolio website, rendered edge to edge at 1440x900 with crisp, readable text and no browser window, device, or desk around it. An award-winning, premium, scroll-driven motion site, frozen mid-scroll so motion is visible. Visitors are founders hiring for web products and AI features, and recruiters; they must read who he is, see the real work (01 Coach Panel — live volleyball match stats; 02 Framely — AI product image & video studio; 03 Falaxy — AI fortune-telling app; 04 Gemini Live voice assistant; 05 Black Books & Coffee — client work; 06 AI Influencer platform — corporate), and find "Let's talk" and the CV. Nav pill: Work · About · CV · Contact with TR / EN.

Visual law: ink ebru (Turkish paper marbling) in black, white and graphite only, real marbling texture with combed patterns, and one single vermilion red vein as the only colour — reserved for the action. Heavy geometric grotesk display type, white and graphite pill controls.

This comp's composition: the marbling vortex becomes a deep tunnel in perspective; projects are a sequence of rings receding into it — 01 Coach Panel nearest and largest showing its real dashboard, then 02 Framely, 03 Falaxy, 04 Gemini Live smaller and deeper, each ring captioned. The name "OĞULCAN CEVIZCI" runs vertically up the left edge as a tall white band with the knockout letters showing the marble through, "Full-Stack & AI Engineer" beside it. The single red vein threads through the centre of every ring like a path and ends at the red "Let's talk" pill bottom right. Scroll is flying the visitor into the tunnel.
